summary_1line: Bhishma recounts a tale where a vulture urges acceptance of death while a jackal exploits grief, confusing mourners over whether to abandon a dead child.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a gloomy cremation ground, grieving relatives clutch a dead child while a vulture perches nearby speaking and a black jackal emerges from a hole to address them.
The mourners sit on the bare ground with the child across their laps as the sun lowers and a vulture argues with a jackal amid smoke from funeral pyres.
At dusk in the cremation ground, dark smoke rises from pyres while owls, jackals, and lions cry out and the vulture warns the men to leave the body behind.
